title: Audimind: Create audiobooks in one AI-powered workspace.
excerpt: Create audiobooks with Audimind. Prepare scripts, use AI or human narration, and edit and mix audio in one collaborative workspace.
content_html:
Generate AI narration, record online, or upload existing recordings. Edit, mix, and collaborate
to turn your manuscript into finished audio.

Start for free

See how it works

Faster audio production, powered by AI

AI supports every key stage of production, reducing repetitive work and helping teams move faster.

Smart Scripting: Turn text into a production-ready script

AI analyzes the Document, splits it into Chapters, separates Narration from Dialogue, identifies Characters, builds Character Profiles, adds Emotion Tags, and provides pronunciation guidance for uncommon or ambiguous words.

Explore Smart Scripting

AI Narration: Distinct voices for every character

Use voice attributes such as age, gender, and style to find AI Voices that suit each character, with batch recommendations for larger casts.

Explore AI Narration

Smart Alignment: Faster Audio-to-Script Matching

Upload long-form raw recordings and let AI transcribe them, split them into clips, and match each clip to its Script segment. Smart Review compares the recording with the Script and flags potential omissions, extra reads, and other differences—turning hours of manual alignment and review into a much faster workflow.

Explore Smart Alignment

AI Toolbox: Create SFX and music on demand

Describe what you need and generate SFX up to 20 seconds. AI Music remains a future capability.

Explore AI Toolbox

Better collaboration, smoother production

Manage Teams and Crews, assign tasks, automate workflows, and collaborate in context—all in one shared workspace.

Automated Workflows

Set up a custom workflow for each Project. Tasks are assigned by Responsibility, and completed work moves automatically to the next stage—keeping progress visible from Script Editing through Review.

Comments & Issue Tracking

Use Comments to discuss voice performance and script changes, and Issues to track misreads and corrections. Every discussion stays linked to the relevant Script segment.

Production Stats & Compensation Estimates

Track each Crew Member’s workload by text volume or hours. Set compensation rates to calculate estimates, then export a detailed report in one click.
